Name: Area Denial Frame
Description: Shoots a burst of 5 projectiles at the cost of 1 Ammo. Projectiles create a lingering damage field after 0.5 seconds of impacting. Damaging Field deals damage every 0.25 seconds for 5.65 seconds, dealing 52.5 [?] damage up to 22 times per field. Enemies can only receive damage from a single field at a time.

Name: Double Fire
Description: Fires 2 rounds at a slight offset from the reticle at the cost of 1 Ammo.

Name: Heavy Burst
Description: Fires 2-round burst. Grants 10?% Flinch Resist when ADS.

Name: Heavy Burst (Hand Cannon)
Description: Fires a 2-round burst that deals 9.5% Increased Weakspot Damage. Not to be confused with Precision Damage, as they are independent of each other, such as shooting a Divinity Cage, or scoring a hit on a weakspot while not being within the Precision Angle Cone. Grants 10% Flinch Resist when ADS.

Name: High-Impact Frame
Description: While moving at or below 2.8 metres per second and ADS: -20% Accuracy Cone Size and -17% Accuracy Cone Growth. Can also work while airborne if the movement speed criteria is met.

Name: High-Impact Frame (Rocket Launchers)
Description: Baseline damage for Rocket Launchers. 1 Impact : 8.7 Explosive Damage Ratio. 46.5 RPM

Name: Legacy PR-55 Frame
Description: While hipfiring: +30? Stability, +1? Precision Angle Threshold, -70?% Accuracy Cone Size, and -?% Accuracy Cone Growth.

Name: Micro-Missile Frame
Description: Passively grants +20 Mobility, and 6.25% Forward Movement Speed Bonus. Deals 50% Decreased Self Damage.

Name: Micro-Missile Frame

Name: MIDA Synergy

Name: Rapid-Fire Frame (Shotguns)

Name: Spread Shot
Description: Fires a spread of 12 pellets, each dealing 30 [?] damage with a 1.2x Precision Multiplier. Pellets disappear after 25 meters, and deal a minimum of 0.33x damage at Maximum Damage Falloff.

Name: Support Frame
Description: Shoots slow, tracking projectiles that travel at a speed of 40m/s. Projectiles do not have a distance limit, but will eventually lose their tracers. Has 50% Increased Aim Assist Falloff Distance at 0 Range, down to 25% at 100 Range, compared to a regular Auto Rifle. Dealing ANY (really, ANY!) damage generates Weapon Energy, at a rate of 1% Energy for every 4 [3.6] damage dealt, reaching 100% Charge after dealing 400 [360] damage. Dealing damage with the Support Auto Rifle doubles the Weapon Energy gains, generating 1% Energy for every 2 [1.8] damage, requiring 200 [180] damage to fully charge. Looking near an ally within range widens the reticle. Hipfiring while an ally is in healing range will shoot healing projectiles that have much stronger tracking. Consumes 2% Weapon Energy per healing shot fired towards an ally, restoring 13.3 HP to them on impact. Targeting Range = 28 + (0.1 x Range Stat) meters, up to 38 Meters at 100 Range. If multiple allies are targeted, then the healing shots will alternate between allies. Upon scoring 5 healing hits within 1 second of each on allies: The next healing hits within 1 seconds of each on allies bestows them with an Element-Matching Effect, and applies Support Frame Boost to the user and the targeted ally. Support Frame Boost grants 10% increased weapon damage for 6 seconds. Stacks with everything. Strand Support Frames cause the targeted ally to release 4 Unraveling Projectiles. Solar Support Frames bestow Restoration x1 for 4+2 seconds to the targeted ally. Void Support Frames bestow 15 Void Overshield for 10+5 seconds to the targeted ally. Only triggers On-Heal Effects upon applying Rapid Healing. Shots that restore missing health count for "on-hit" related interactions. Incurs a 1.5 second cooldown upon applying Support Frame Boost before additional healing hits are counted on the same ally.

Name: Together Forever
Description: Weapon Kills refill Sturm and grant it an Overcharged Bullet with increased damage, up to 25 Sturm Overcharge stacks. Scoring an additional Weapon Kill within 3 seconds of the first grants 3 Sturm Overcharge stacks. Further Weapon Kills within ? seconds of the last grant 5 Sturm Overcharge stacks.
